metabolic_screening.label: Newborn Metabolic Screening (blood spot)
metabolic_screening.program: Minnesota Department of Health — Newborn Screening Program
metabolic_screening.opt_out_form_label: Parental Refusal or Delay of Newborn Screening
metabolic_screening.state_form_system: MDH form — Parental Refusal or Delay of Newborn Screening (rev. 01/2025). Parents may refuse or delay any part (blood spot, hearing, pulse oximetry). Signed form must be made part of the infant's medical record and a copy sent to MDH within 7 days (MN Stat. 144.125).
metabolic_screening.midwife_role: Complete the Parental Refusal or Delay form; signed form goes into medical record, copy to MDH NBS (P.O. Box 64899, St. Paul, MN 55164-0899; fax 651-215-6285; email health.newbornscreening@state.mn.us).
metabolic_screening.declination_law: MN Stat. 144.125 — newborn screening required; parental refusal or delay permitted; signed form required in medical record and submitted to MDH within 7 days.

hearing_screening.label: Newborn Hearing Screening
hearing_screening.program: Minnesota Department of Health — EHDI Program
hearing_screening.opt_out_form_label: Parental Refusal or Delay of Newborn Screening (covers hearing component)
hearing_screening.state_form_note: Same Parental Refusal or Delay form covers hearing screening refusal/delay. Parents may select which parts to refuse or delay.
hearing_screening.midwife_role: Educate parents; if objection, complete the refusal/delay section for hearing on the Parental Refusal or Delay form.

cchd_screening.label: CCHD Pulse Oximetry Screening
cchd_screening.program: Minnesota Department of Health — Newborn Screening Program
cchd_screening.opt_out_form_label: Parental Refusal or Delay of Newborn Screening (covers pulse oximetry component)
cchd_screening.state_form_note: Same Parental Refusal or Delay form covers pulse oximetry refusal/delay. Parents may select which parts to refuse or delay.
cchd_screening.midwife_role: Perform or refer for pulse ox; if objection, complete the refusal/delay section for pulse oximetry on the Parental Refusal or Delay form.

erythromycin_eye_ointment.label: Erythromycin Eye Ointment (newborn eye prophylaxis)
erythromycin_eye_ointment.program: Minnesota law — not part of the NBS program
erythromycin_eye_ointment.state_form_note: No standalone state declination form for eye prophylaxis; documented via medical record refusal.
erythromycin_eye_ointment.midwife_role: If declining: document refusal in medical record. If administering: apply within 1h of birth.

vitamin_k.label: Vitamin K (oral or injection)
vitamin_k.midwife_role: Three-way informed choice (oral / shot / none) documented in medical record; midwife administers injection if chosen.

hepatitis_b_vaccine.label: Hepatitis B Vaccine (birth dose)
hepatitis_b_vaccine.program: Minnesota Department of Health — Immunization Program
hepatitis_b_vaccine.midwife_role: Birth-dose consent or declination documented in writing; report to Minnesota Immunization Registry (MIIC).

gestational_diabetes.label: Gestational Diabetes Screening (prenatal)
gestational_diabetes.midwife_role: Prenatal informed choice; midwife refers out for glucose testing when declined.

group_b_strep.label: Group B Strep Screening & Prophylaxis (prenatal)
group_b_strep.midwife_role: Prenatal informed choice per ACOG/CDC; swab testing via referral or in-office; intrapartum antibiotics referred if opted-in.
